rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Microsoft Outlook integration server that provides access to email and calendar operations through Azure AD device code authentication with persistent token caching. Built with Node.js and the Microsoft Graph API, it offers mail tools for listing inbox messages, reading full email content, and sending new emails, plus calendar tools for viewing upcoming events and creating new meetings with automatic Microsoft Teams integration.
